purpose: Constructive source-only sensitivity to identified beta/gamma ceilings, optimisation ridges and practice confounds. Additional exploratory development, not a retry or untouched test.
source: Unchanged real train1–5 individuals rat0–5/human0–11; condition heldout individuals1–7 and score6–7. No native8–25 or agent fits.
information: Unchanged conditional legal-neighbour likelihood, observed first cells/full recorded paths/native success, gaps reset outcomehistory only, optimalopenmap/knownreward prior. Free temperature is an extension of original fixed-temperature SR.

practice.availability: Trial count/layout boundaries are declared experimental covariates, not a hidden-change detector or transferable agent input; omitted trials never imputed.

starts.points: First10 of random_base2(m=4), map full bounds; set inactive coefficients0

selection: Within family choose gamma/start by minimum TRAINING negative mean moveLL; tie lowergamma/start. Validation does not select candidates in v2, but v1 source validation was already inspected, so this is exploratory.

profile.interpretation: Minimum train loss across gamma/start at each fixedbq; inspect sign/ridges/individual predictive changes. No automatic asymptotic confidence interval or species mechanism.

technical_requirements: Numba and independent NumPy comparisons for all6 families/3gammas/2species
Zero practice slopes reproduce unchanged v1 kernel, including all flags/resets
Practice covariates use past trial count/rawordinal only; causal outcome/future-isolation checks
No-overwrite reservations and bound protocol/code/cache/data/driver/auditor GO

failure_policy: Preserve all failures and optimiser statuses, no silent retry. Convergence does not imply an identified gate.
future: Register regime-matched synthetic recovery, including estimated gamma/temperature and gamma reselection, before recovery fits. Shared/pooled/separate and closed-loop transfer follow recoverable functions and relevant practice controls.
scope: No target native or digital layouts8–25, no transport, no paper success/submission claim.
